## Original request

The copy and bro buttons should go under the corresponding text. the top border of these buttons should jam right up against the bottom of the text box. they should make space for themselves on hover over the text box but remain exposed while hovering over them. they should make space for themselves but otherwise they should take up no space when they are not visible.

details.label: Goal
details.value: Position the copy and bro buttons directly beneath their corresponding text box, with their top border flush against its bottom edge. Reveal them and reserve space when hovering over the text box, keep them visible while hovering over the buttons, and collapse their space when hidden.

details.label: Requested proof
details.value: Hover over a text box and show that its corresponding buttons appear directly below it with no gap and reserve enough space. Move the pointer onto the buttons and verify they remain visible. Move away from both and verify the buttons disappear and occupy no layout space.

details.label: Known facts
details.value: The request concerns the copy and bro buttons associated with each text box.

details.label: Constraints
details.value: Buttons must be flush against the bottom of their corresponding text box, remain exposed while hovered, and occupy no space when hidden.

result.summary:
Factory’s Copy and Bro buttons now appear flush beneath their text box. They stay visible as the pointer moves onto either button and give back their layout space when it leaves, even while Bro is active.
